items.title: Insta360 turns its action cameras into free 3D scanners — Spatial Capture tool uses Gaussian Splatting to build 3D models with 4 free renders a month
items.excerpt: Insta360 has launched Spatial Capture, a free feature that uses 3D Gaussian Splatting to turn short 360 videos into explorable 3D models of indoor spaces.
items.rationale: New free feature turns a consumer 360 camera into a Gaussian-splat 3D scanner, so designers get cheap room capture for spatial and interior work.

items.title: Meta open sources code to let you make Muse AI gadgets
items.rationale: Concrete new release: Meta opens Home Link code so makers can build their own Muse-powered hardware, which opens a prototyping path for AI device designers.

items.title: Nvidia introduces 64GB DGX Spark to throw local AI fans a lifeline amid the RAMpocalypse — new GB10 config starts at $4999 for those who can work with less
items.excerpt: Less memory, lower price, otherwise identical
items.rationale: New lower-priced 64GB DGX Spark config makes a local-AI desktop box more affordable for studios that run models on their own hardware.

items.title: Gemini fully replaces Google Assistant on Android
items.excerpt: At the start of September, the Google Assistant deprecation on mobile got underway. It now looks to be widely rolling out.
items.rationale: Platform milestone: Assistant is gone from Android phones and Gemini is now the default voice layer, which changes the baseline for anyone designing voice or assistant flows.

items.title: Apple is reportedly building a smart home camera that won't record video footage of you or anyone else
items.excerpt: The device will apparently use AI to analyze activity in your home without actually filming it.
items.rationale: Newly reported Apple device that uses on-device AI to sense activity without storing footage, a privacy-by-design hardware pattern not covered before.
